name: Otisdub Tag
summary:
Otisdub Tag is a Gorilla Tag fan game made by Otisdub. It has many features, including:

1. One map and three WIP maps!
2. Two cosmetics!
3. A Rec Room remake! ^OtisdubTag by Stungspore

And more!



WIP MAPS:

Map 1: Outdoors
Outdoors is a fun map. The map is just some grass and trees, making it a good hangout spot. As the name implies, this map is outside!

Map 2: Cosmetics
Cosmetics is where you get the two cosmetics for the game. There is also a mirror in this map so you can look at your outfit!
